name: Python Application
description: Run any Python 3 application or bot inside an isolated Docker container. Supports pip packages via requirements.txt. Suitable for Discord bots, web scrapers, automation scripts, Flask/FastAPI web servers, and more.
author: Arc Panel

envVariableDefinitions.name: Main Python File
envVariableDefinitions.description: The entry point Python file to execute (relative to the server root).

envVariableDefinitions.name: Requirements File
envVariableDefinitions.description: Path to requirements.txt file for pip package installation.

envVariableDefinitions.name: Unbuffered Output
envVariableDefinitions.description: Set to 1 to see real-time Python output in the console.

envVariableDefinitions.name: Timezone
envVariableDefinitions.description: Timezone for the container (e.g., UTC, America/New_York, Europe/London).
